_comment: Template. Copy this file, rename it, and the bot picks it up as /panel <filename>. Add "banner": "https://..." for a header image.

sections.title: 📄  SECTION HEADER
sections.body:
> Lines starting with '> ' render as a quote block, which is what gives
> the sections that indented, bordered look.

Plain lines outside the quote render normally. **Bold**, *italic* and `code` all work.

sections.title: 🎯  ANOTHER SECTION
sections.body:
> Up to 9 sections per panel (Discord's limit is 10 embeds, the banner takes one).
> Add "thumbnail": "https://..." to a section for a small image on its right.
